title: Who founded the Vijayanagara Empire?
description: Who founded the Vijayanagara Empire in 1336?
hint: The founders were two brothers.
summary: Harihara I and Bukka I founded the Vijayanagara Empire.

title: When was the Vijayanagara Empire founded?
description: In which year was the Vijayanagara Empire traditionally founded?
hint: It was founded in the 14th century.
summary: The Vijayanagara Empire was founded in 1336.

title: What was the capital of the Vijayanagara Empire?
description: Which city served as the principal capital of the Vijayanagara Empire?
hint: The ruins are located in present-day Karnataka.
summary: Vijayanagara, located at present-day Hampi, was the capital.

title: In which present-day state was Vijayanagara located?
description: The core territory of the Vijayanagara Empire was centered in which present-day Indian state?
hint: Hampi is located in this state.
summary: The Vijayanagara capital was located in present-day Karnataka.

title: Which river flowed near the capital of Vijayanagara?
description: Which major river flowed beside the Vijayanagara capital at Hampi?
hint: It is one of the major rivers of the Deccan.
summary: The Tungabhadra River flowed beside Vijayanagara.

title: Which was the first ruling dynasty of Vijayanagara?
description: Which dynasty was the first of the four major ruling dynasties of Vijayanagara?
hint: It was the dynasty of the founders.
summary: The Sangama dynasty was the first ruling dynasty.

title: Which dynasty succeeded the Sangama dynasty?
description: Which dynasty replaced the Sangama dynasty in Vijayanagara?
hint: It was the second major ruling dynasty.
summary: The Saluva dynasty succeeded the Sangama dynasty.

title: Which dynasty did Krishnadevaraya belong to?
description: Krishnadevaraya, the most famous Vijayanagara ruler, belonged to which dynasty?
hint: He was a ruler of the third dynasty.
summary: Krishnadevaraya belonged to the Tuluva dynasty.

title: Who was the most famous ruler of Vijayanagara?
description: Which ruler is widely regarded as the greatest ruler of the Vijayanagara Empire?
hint: He belonged to the Tuluva dynasty.
summary: Krishnadevaraya was the most famous ruler of Vijayanagara.

title: When did Krishnadevaraya become ruler?
description: In which year did Krishnadevaraya ascend the throne of Vijayanagara?
hint: His reign began in the early 16th century.
summary: Krishnadevaraya ascended the throne in 1509.

title: Which title is associated with Krishnadevaraya?
description: Which famous honorific title is traditionally associated with Krishnadevaraya?
hint: The title compares him with Bhoja.
summary: Krishnadevaraya is traditionally known as Andhra Bhoja.

title: Which literary work was written by Krishnadevaraya?
description: Which famous Telugu literary work was authored by Krishnadevaraya?
hint: The title begins with 'Amukta'.
summary: Amuktamalyada was written by Krishnadevaraya.

title: In which language was Amuktamalyada written?
description: Krishnadevaraya wrote Amuktamalyada primarily in which language?
hint: It is a major South Indian literary language.
summary: Amuktamalyada was written in Telugu.

title: Who were the Ashtadiggajas?
description: The Ashtadiggajas were associated with the court of which Vijayanagara ruler?
hint: They were eight celebrated Telugu poets.
summary: The Ashtadiggajas were eight celebrated Telugu poets associated with Krishnadevaraya's court.

title: Who was Allasani Peddana?
description: Allasani Peddana was a famous poet associated with which ruler's court?
hint: He was considered one of the Ashtadiggajas.
summary: Allasani Peddana was a celebrated poet in Krishnadevaraya's court.

title: Which work is associated with Allasani Peddana?
description: Which literary work was composed by Allasani Peddana?
hint: It is a celebrated Telugu prabandha.
summary: Manucharitramu is associated with Allasani Peddana.

title: Which Portuguese traveller visited Vijayanagara during Krishnadevaraya's reign?
description: Which Portuguese traveller left an important account of Vijayanagara during the reign of Krishnadevaraya?
hint: His name begins with Domingo.
summary: Domingo Paes visited Vijayanagara during Krishnadevaraya's reign.

title: Who was Fernao Nuniz?
description: Fernao Nuniz was a traveller who visited Vijayanagara during the reign of which ruler?
hint: He visited during the period following Krishnadevaraya.
summary: Fernao Nuniz visited Vijayanagara during the reign of Achyuta Deva Raya.

title: Which Persian traveller visited Vijayanagara in the 15th century?
description: Which Persian envoy and traveller visited Vijayanagara during the reign of Devaraya II?
hint: He was an envoy from the Timurid court.
summary: Abdur Razzaq visited Vijayanagara during the reign of Devaraya II.

title: Which Italian traveller visited Vijayanagara?
description: Which Italian traveller visited Vijayanagara in the 15th century?
hint: He was a traveller from Venice.
summary: Niccolo Conti visited Vijayanagara in the 15th century.

title: Which battle led to the decline of Vijayanagara?
description: Which battle in 1565 dealt a major blow to the Vijayanagara Empire?
hint: It was fought near Talikota.
summary: The Battle of Talikota in 1565 dealt a major blow to Vijayanagara.

title: Who led Vijayanagara forces at the Battle of Talikota?
description: Who was the influential Vijayanagara regent who led the empire's forces at Talikota?
hint: He was the brother-in-law of Sadasiva Raya.
summary: Aliya Rama Raya led the Vijayanagara forces at the Battle of Talikota.

title: Which dynasty ruled Vijayanagara during the Battle of Talikota?
description: The ruler Sadasiva Raya belonged nominally to which dynasty?
hint: It was the third major Vijayanagara dynasty.
summary: Sadasiva Raya belonged to the Tuluva dynasty.

title: Which was the last ruling dynasty of Vijayanagara?
description: Which dynasty was the fourth and final major ruling dynasty of Vijayanagara?
hint: It followed the Tuluva dynasty.
summary: The Aravidu dynasty was the last major ruling dynasty.

title: Who founded the Aravidu dynasty?
description: Who established the Aravidu dynasty after the Battle of Talikota?
hint: He was the younger brother of Aliya Rama Raya.
summary: Tirumala Deva Raya established the Aravidu dynasty.

title: Which monument at Hampi is famous for its stone chariot?
description: Which Vijayanagara monument contains the famous stone chariot at Hampi?
hint: It is dedicated to Lord Vishnu's form Vithoba/Vittala.
summary: The Vittala Temple at Hampi is famous for its stone chariot.

title: Which temple at Hampi is dedicated to Virupaksha?
description: Which famous temple complex at Hampi is dedicated to Lord Virupaksha?
hint: It is located near the Hampi Bazaar.
summary: The Virupaksha Temple is one of the most important temples at Hampi.

title: Who built the Krishna Temple at Hampi?
description: The Krishna Temple at Hampi was built by which Vijayanagara ruler?
hint: The temple commemorated a military victory in eastern Andhra.
summary: Krishnadevaraya built the Krishna Temple at Hampi.

title: Which temple at Hampi is known for Ramayana panels?
description: Which Vijayanagara temple is particularly noted for extensive Ramayana-related carvings?
hint: Its name refers to a large number of depictions.
summary: The Hazara Rama Temple is known for its Ramayana panels.

title: Which architectural style dominates Vijayanagara temples?
description: The major temples of Vijayanagara are primarily associated with which South Indian architectural tradition?
hint: It developed prominently in South India.
summary: Vijayanagara temples are primarily associated with the Dravidian architectural tradition.

title: What are gopurams?
description: What architectural feature became particularly prominent in Vijayanagara temple complexes?
hint: They are monumental entrance towers.
summary: Gopurams are monumental gateway towers commonly found in South Indian temples.

title: What was the Queen's Bath at Hampi?
description: The Queen's Bath at Hampi is best described as what type of structure?
hint: It is a large enclosed water structure.
summary: The Queen's Bath is a large royal bathing structure at Hampi.

title: What is the Lotus Mahal?
description: The Lotus Mahal at Hampi is a distinctive structure associated with which architectural complex?
hint: It is located in the Zenana Enclosure.
summary: The Lotus Mahal is an ornate structure in the Zenana Enclosure at Hampi.

title: What was the Elephant Stables at Hampi used for?
description: The famous Elephant Stables at Hampi were built primarily to house what?
hint: The name gives away the purpose.
summary: The Elephant Stables were used to house royal elephants.

title: What was the Mahanavami Dibba?
description: The Mahanavami Dibba at Hampi was mainly associated with what?
hint: It was used for royal ceremonial activities.
summary: The Mahanavami Dibba was a large ceremonial platform used for royal functions.

title: Which festival was associated with the Mahanavami Dibba?
description: The Mahanavami Dibba was associated with celebrations of which major festival?
hint: It is celebrated during the Navaratri period.
summary: The Mahanavami festival was celebrated with royal ceremonies at the Mahanavami Dibba.

title: Against whom did Krishnadevaraya campaign in Odisha?
description: Krishnadevaraya fought major campaigns against which eastern Indian kingdom?
hint: The ruler belonged to the Gajapati dynasty.
summary: Krishnadevaraya fought the Gajapati rulers of Odisha.

title: Which fort was captured by Krishnadevaraya from the Gajapatis?
description: Which important fort in present-day Andhra Pradesh was captured by Krishnadevaraya during his eastern campaign?
hint: It is located in present-day Andhra Pradesh.
summary: Krishnadevaraya captured Udayagiri during his campaign against the Gajapatis.

title: Which neighbouring power frequently fought Vijayanagara in its early period?
description: Which northern Deccan state was a major rival of Vijayanagara during its early history?
hint: Its capital was Gulbarga and later Bidar.
summary: The Bahmani Sultanate was a major rival of Vijayanagara.

title: Which powers fought against Vijayanagara at Talikota?
description: The Vijayanagara Empire was defeated at Talikota by an alliance of which Deccan Sultanates?
hint: The alliance came from the Deccan.
summary: The Deccan Sultanates formed the alliance that defeated Vijayanagara at Talikota.

title: Which traveller described the wealth of Vijayanagara under Krishnadevaraya?
description: Which Portuguese traveller gave an important description of Vijayanagara during Krishnadevaraya's reign?
hint: He was a Portuguese traveller.
summary: Domingo Paes described the wealth and grandeur of Vijayanagara.

title: What did Abdur Razzaq emphasize about Vijayanagara?
description: Abdur Razzaq's account of Vijayanagara particularly noted the city's extensive fortifications and grandeur.
hint: Think about the city's defensive structures.
summary: Abdur Razzaq described the impressive scale and fortifications of Vijayanagara.

title: What was the Nayankara system?
description: The Nayankara system in Vijayanagara was primarily associated with what?
hint: It involved military chiefs receiving territories.
summary: The Nayankara system involved granting territories to military chiefs called Nayakas in return for service.

title: Who were the Nayakas?
description: Who were the Nayakas in the Vijayanagara administrative system?
hint: They were powerful military chiefs.
summary: Nayakas were military chiefs who controlled assigned territories and provided military service.

title: Who succeeded Harihara I?
description: Who succeeded Harihara I as an important early ruler of Vijayanagara?
hint: He was the other founder-brother.
summary: Bukka I succeeded Harihara I.

title: Who succeeded Harihara I as ruler?
description: Which founder-brother became ruler of Vijayanagara after Harihara I?
hint: He was the second founder-brother.
summary: Bukka I succeeded Harihara I.

title: Who was one of the most powerful rulers of the Sangama dynasty?
description: Which Sangama ruler is known for strengthening Vijayanagara and expanding its influence?
hint: He was the second Deva Raya.
summary: Devaraya II was one of the most powerful rulers of the Sangama dynasty.

title: Who visited Vijayanagara during the reign of Devaraya II?
description: Which Persian traveller visited the court of Devaraya II?
hint: He was an envoy from Persia.
summary: Abdur Razzaq visited Vijayanagara during Devaraya II's reign.

title: Which deity was particularly associated with the Vijayanagara state?
description: Which form of Shiva was the chief deity of the Virupaksha Temple and an important state cult at Vijayanagara?
hint: The famous temple at Hampi bears this deity's name.
summary: Virupaksha, a form of Shiva, was an important deity at Vijayanagara.

title: What is the UNESCO World Heritage Site associated with Vijayanagara?
description: What is the official UNESCO World Heritage Site name for the historic remains of Vijayanagara?
hint: It is named after the modern location of the ruins.
summary: The Group of Monuments at Hampi is a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
